changes.name: Laivakangas (Laiva) Gold Mine
changes.previous: RTO and environmental permit appeal pending; mine restart being evaluated.
changes.current: Updated CSE listing statement submitted. Environmental permit leave to appeal pending; no RTO close or commercial restart confirmed.
changes.confidence: A (issuer releases; financing and permit conditions remain)

changes.name: Kearney Graphite Mine
changes.previous: Previously producing mine; restart and feasibility evaluation underway.

changes.confidence: A (issuer release; target and test only)
